title: MVP: agent status + per-agent control UI (start/stop/pause/resume/cancel) once backend supports it
body: Dashboard UI: show per-agent status (live) and per-agent control operations (start/stop/pause/resume/cancel) plus the existing project/pipeline controls (stop/pause/resume, approve/reject, answer prompts, rerun scopes).
